svg.title: A stale eval set showing high pass rate on old cases and a hidden failure on new production traffic
svg.desc: A black canvas shows two panels side by side. The left panel, labeled eval set, last updated eight months ago, shows a bar at 96 percent pass rate. The right panel, labeled current production traffic, shows a much lower bar at 71 percent pass rate on a sample of recent runs, illustrating that a static eval set can report a stable score while real production quality has already dropped.
svg.text: A STALE EVAL SET IN ONE CHART

g.text: EVAL SET · last updated 8 months ago
pass rate on a fresh labeled sample

svg.text: the eval set never failed. it just stopped asking questions users actually ask now.
